title: Sharḥ-i Gulshan-i Rāz
transliterated_title: Sharḥ-i Gulshan-i Rāz (Commentary on Shabistarī's Garden of Secrets)

date.basis: The sole copy (MS 3318) is undated (10th-13th/16th-19th c.) and does not name the author; the entry gives no date of composition.

addressee: A Sulṭān Muḥammad, perhaps Sulṭān Muḥammad b. Bāysunghur (Melvin-Koushki; footnote asks if the ruler of Gulbarga)
manuscript: MS 3318, Central Library, Tehran University: defective, the only known copy, apparently appended to MS Majlis 10196 from Bahār's library.
majlis_folios: none (MS 3318 is a separate defective copy apparently appended to MS Majlis 10196; no folios of the Majlis foliation given)
summary: A Persian commentary on Shabistarī's Garden of Secrets whose attribution to Ibn Turka is likely on context and content but not certain.
edition_note: Ed. Kāẓim Dizfūliyān, Tehran 1996; the edition title labels the commentator Shiʿi, a reception fact rather than evidence.
